reason: A read-only static analysis plugin that scans repositories for common code smells and returns severity-ranked findings with actionable remediation suggestions.

summaries.zh: 这是一个只读的代码气味分析插件，用于扫描仓库中的遗留标记、未实现桩、超长行、大文件和重复代码块，并生成按严重度排序的修复建议。
summaries.en: A read-only code smell analysis plugin that scans repositories for debt markers, stubs, long lines, oversized files, and duplicate blocks, then produces severity-ranked fix suggestions.

capabilities: Reads repository files and directory metadata
Performs static detection of TODO/FIXME/HACK markers, stubs, long lines, oversized files, and duplicate code blocks
Produces severity-ranked reports and fix suggestions
